metadata.pagesDescription: Blind technical hiring for the 42 network — challenges, blind review, and AI interview guides.

home.heroBody: The hiring marketplace built exclusively for 42 students. Prove what you can do with custom technical challenges — and let companies hire on proof, not paperwork.
home.previewCaption: Identity stays hidden until the interview. Recruiters see scores and an AI interview guide — not a name or CV.
home.stepsLead: From job post to scored submission — a straight line. No extra tools for recruiters or candidates.
home.step1Body: PDF, Word, or plain text. AI extracts the role, stack, and requirements.
home.step2Body: A custom take-home challenge, tailored to the role. Ready in seconds.
home.step3Body: Code is reviewed blind. The company receives a score and interview guide — not a CV.
home.bothLead: One platform: credible screens for companies, fair proof for developers.
home.forCompaniesBody: Evaluate 42 school talent on real work, not pedigree. AI scoring and an interview guide are included — so HR can run a credible technical screen without pulling engineers off the roadmap.
home.forDevelopersBody: A fair way to prove yourself, regardless of background. Your code is the application — reviewed blind until you choose to move forward.
home.visionQuote: Fair hiring means judging people on what they can build — not where they studied.
home.ctaLead: Prove what you can build — or hire on proof, not paperwork.
